newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit falls as dollar/yen gains on Japan news.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit falls as dollar/yen gains on Japan news.

text.p: The late rise of the dollar/yen on news out of Japan depressed the ringgit in muted trading, dealers said.

The ringgit kept within its narrow forecast range as local news pegs remained scarce amid thinly staffed trading desks, they said. "Dollar/yen exploded so ringgit just followed it," said a Malaysian bank dealer.

The yen skidded in late Asian trading in reaction to the 2.60 percent plunge of the Nikkei stock index to below 20,000 points. The yen's weakness was also due to a Japanese official's call for decontrol of participation in foreign exchange trading.
Around 0900 GMT, ringgit was at 2.5255/60 a dollar, down from 2.5238/48 at the Wednesday local close.
Dealers said the ringgit may weaken further into European and U.S. trading on Thursday, if the dollar strengthened further against other major currencies.
